scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n frontend,backend -c blue,green "npm run dev --workspace @estatepro/frontend" "npm run dev --workspace @estatepro/backend"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @estatepro/backend && npm run build --workspace @estatepro/frontend
scripts.start: concurrently -k -n frontend,backend -c blue,green "npm run start --workspace @estatepro/frontend" "npm run start --workspace @estatepro/backend"
